2. Final Guest Count. Client must confirm the final guest count no later than 10 days before the Event. The final count may not be lower than the guaranteed minimum, and Client will be charged for the final count or the actual number served, whichever is greater.

7. Allergies. Caterer will accommodate dietary requirements notified with the final guest count. Caterer cannot guarantee an allergen-free environment.
